svg.title: Retaining project cash reduces the additional source needed at maturity
svg.desc: Conditional hybrid: April 21 operating illustration, May executed financing and June assumed amortization start. The May 15, 2031 payment is 2,836.567 million dollars. With assumed opening eligible resources of 344.8 million and 331 million of net cash before maturity, retaining 350.808 million of modeled residual leaves 1,809.958 million of additional net funding required. Paying that residual out raises the requirement to 2,160.767 million. Neither additional funding nor reserve eligibility is established. No expected loss or default probability is shown.
